work_packages.title: Recover baseline and phase boundaries
work_packages.goal: Continue current implementation and make this local-only phase explicit.
deliverables: Current HEAD/working-tree and existing-work receipt; no reset or scaffold.
Existing-to-new requirement mapping, frozen-evaluation digests, and permission matrix.
New local-phase ledger alongside, not instead of, previous roadmap and receipts.

acceptance.requirement: Record the actual HEAD and preserve unknown/uncommitted work; rebase decisions are explicit, not automatic.
Historical evaluation and receipt trees are fingerprinted and unchanged after bootstrap.
Runtime network, model-budget and local-action policy default to no external access/no new provider calls.
Baseline checks are executed where available; unavailable checks remain not_run and are not described as passed.

work_packages.title: Repair scoped permission semantics
work_packages.goal: Prevent overstated feasible access before analysis becomes more prominent.
deliverables: Reproducing module and API tests for conditional denies in every supported policy layer.
Conditional/blocked/unresolved precedence and explicit unsupported-semantics handling.
One authoritative result used by paths, change review, aftermath and UI.

acceptance.requirement: Boundary, session-policy and SCP conditional-deny fixtures reproduce the old behavior and return conditional after repair.
A definitely applicable unconditional deny remains blocked; missing controlling inputs cannot become feasible.
Unsupported policy constructs and case-sensitive resource identifiers are exercised and conservatively handled within declared support.
The API, change review, aftermath and MCP expose consistent decision and evidence, without changing frozen evaluation records.

work_packages.title: Harden recipe conclusions and incomplete work
work_packages.goal: Make recipes rigorous enough to drive an investigator rather than just produce plausible explanations.
deliverables: Recipe result version with obligation/query status and explicit unavailable/budget outcomes.
Namespace-aware follow-on pivots and page continuations.
Observable hypothesis predicates separated from intent and approval.

acceptance.requirement: Budget exhaustion, a null coverage result, a failed page and zero configured observers each remain partial/unknown and cannot imply visibility.
A decisive event beyond the first 100 results is retrieved or explicitly outstanding; no silent completion.
Same raw actor/session/run IDs under unrelated authorities do not support a joint hypothesis.
Failed logins followed by success and benign activity never alone establish malicious guessing; allowed tool calls never alone establish approval.

work_packages.title: Define run provenance and capability contracts
work_packages.goal: Separate local execution, fixture delivery, model output and external validation.
deliverables: Versioned run/blueprint/verification contracts, schema validators and migration proposal.
Orthogonal local-run provenance without redefining synthetic/live compatibility.
Support matrix separating rendered, declared, instrumented, local-verified and externally verified.

acceptance.requirement: Existing synthetic/live examples remain valid or receive an explicit tested versioned migration; no silent semantic relabeling.
Local recorded activity always exposes synthetic-data and local-scope qualifiers in API/UI/MCP/export.
Every new contract rejects unknown executable, credential and arbitrary-target fields.
Capability badges derive from scoped receipts, not from a surface family name or an LLM declaration.

work_packages.title: Compile local application blueprints
work_packages.goal: Create coherent local worlds without hand-authoring the whole graph.
deliverables: Reviewed templates for SaaS, agent workspace and delivery/identity.
Inert descriptor import, preview and deterministic plan compiler.
Stable asset/route/identity assignment and explicit observation gaps.

acceptance.requirement: An empty workspace can preview all three templates without provider credentials.
Untrusted Compose/OpenAPI/manifest strings are treated as data; scripts, interpolation, remote refs and executable assets are rejected or ignored explicitly.
Same blueprint version/seed yields the same logical graph and layout proposal; changed input yields a new revision.
Adding a service preserves unrelated identities and coordinates; ambiguous routes stay ambiguous.

work_packages.title: Own and isolate the local runtime
work_packages.goal: Build a run controller that cannot target arbitrary services merely because they are local.
deliverables: Run-owned endpoint registry, nonce handshake, temp directories, process manifests and least-authority tokens.
Start/pause/resume/clone/stop/cleanup lifecycle; separate monotonic enforcement deadline.
Trusted host-process mode and optional constrained operator-launched container profile.

acceptance.requirement: A different localhost service, redirect, metadata/LAN/public address or unregistered endpoint is refused before action.
A run token cannot reach another run or a non-lab project; forged environment labels do not grant authority.
Stopping/aborting cleans only manifest-owned resources and records cleanup failure without removing user files.
Frozen scenario time cannot suspend wall-clock limits; resource and network controls are checked or the execution mode is explicitly restricted/refused.

work_packages.title: Run instrumented services and independent observers
work_packages.goal: Exercise actual local operations and effects, not only synthetic event insertion.
deliverables: Local gateway, auth/API, tenant data, queue/worker and artifact/token services with controlled data.
Per-operation effect observer with run/resource identity and health intervals.
CLI/UI setup that identifies exactly which local capabilities are reporting.

acceptance.requirement: A real local request reaches the expected service and appears identically in API, browser and MCP evidence.
A permitted operation and a prohibited operation produce independently observed outcomes under the current policy.
A deliberate observer outage becomes unknown for the affected interval, not a no-effect conclusion.
Every source has independent declared authority; relayed/self-reported records cannot corroborate themselves.

work_packages.title: Build a finite scenario and fault DSL
work_packages.goal: Make local worlds repeatable and variable without handing AI arbitrary execution.
deliverables: Finite actions, event schedules, benign distractors, isolated mutations and deterministic seeds.
Separate private-truth store, observable evidence store and investigator output.
Snapshot/reset and partial-run accounting.

acceptance.requirement: DSL cannot execute scripts, shell, plugins or unrestricted network requests.
Same seed/action schedule reproduces intended state; runtime timing differences are recorded, not hidden.
Missing/delayed/dropped evidence affects observability without rewriting private operation truth.
Investigator views contain no answer labels, hidden seeds, expected action IDs or oracle credentials.

work_packages.title: Add investigation contracts and obligations
work_packages.goal: Turn a case question into auditable evidence requirements.
deliverables: Versioned case contract with public goal, targets, interval, hypothesis and obligation state.
Explicit negative-claim coverage requirements and closure prerequisites.
Transition ledger linked to evidence/query revisions.

acceptance.requirement: Contracts derive from public case scope and supported recipes, never private scenario truth.
An obligation is satisfied only by the required scoped evidence or a documented inapplicability reason.
An incomplete investigation can honestly conclude unresolved without asserting a negative or malicious intent.
Changing scope or evidence invalidates affected obligations without overwriting previous decisions.

work_packages.title: Execute bounded investigation plans
work_packages.goal: Give AI a reliable next evidence step with resumable work.
deliverables: Typed query-plan jobs, continuations, quotas, cancellation and restart state.
Scope-safe pivots using declared identities, routes, run/resource IDs and versions.
Per-step purpose, results, errors, completeness and budget counters.

acceptance.requirement: A key event beyond page one is fetched under a stable snapshot without duplicate/skip at tied timestamps.
No tool accepts raw SQL, arbitrary paths, unrestricted graph queries or source credentials.
Restart resumes from committed job state; cancellation/revocation stops further authorized work.
Budget/truncation/error states remain explicit and do not mark downstream obligations satisfied.

work_packages.title: Deliver compact evidence and check claims
work_packages.goal: Reduce model overload without hiding decisive records or uncertainty.
deliverables: Versioned compact packets with exact refs, roles, exposure records, revisions and continuations.
Structured claim checker for scoped predicates plus unsupported-narrative flags.
Non-destructive packet expansion and counterevidence preservation.

acceptance.requirement: A summary never substitutes for a missing required record; packet omissions are machine-readable.
Citations to existing but not retrieved records fail availability checks; cross-run/revision refs fail scope checks.
Arbitrary natural-language support is not labeled machine-proved merely because IDs exist.
Counterevidence, source uncertainty and partial query status survive packet size limits and exports.

work_packages.title: Expose a focused MCP workflow
work_packages.goal: Make the common investigation loop simpler than choosing among all tools.
deliverables: Focused read-only and analyst-service profiles, capability negotiation and stable output envelopes.
Open/read contract, next bounded step, inspect refs and propose conclusion actions.
Real stdio tests and an exportable configuration for an existing coding agent.

acceptance.requirement: Both profiles receive only permitted project/run evidence and the same records as the UI.
Case/job writes have correct annotations and backend privileges; viewer cannot persist a change by calling a nominal read tool.
Prompt text in an event/tool result cannot change profile, budget, target or approval policy.
Tool outputs are bounded with resumable refs; disconnected clients can resume without hidden extra model calls.

work_packages.title: Build the investigation workbench
work_packages.goal: Make obligations, hypotheses and AI drafts useful to a human reviewing the case.
deliverables: Case progress, evidence/coverage questions, competing hypotheses and next-action panel.
Versioned agent proposals separate from accepted case records.
Shared anchors linking castle selections and actual evidence.

acceptance.requirement: Changing cases aborts stale reads and preserves unsaved drafts in the correct scope.
A user can reach supporting/counterevidence, failed queries and uncertainty without navigating a 3D camera.
Agent completion cannot silently resolve an unanswered case question or erase a person’s note.
Keyboard/reduced-motion/narrow-screen automated workflows retain the same critical evidence and status.

work_packages.title: Add bounded path and change exploration
work_packages.goal: Make why-can-this-reach-that and what-changed inspectable.
deliverables: Provenance-linked conditional path inspector with explicit unsupported prerequisites.
Local/snapshot change comparisons for grants, routes, tools and artifacts.
Candidate state hashes and deterministic analysis receipts.

acceptance.requirement: Conditional permission never animates as observed use; unsupported provider semantics remain unresolved.
A proposed candidate cannot modify baseline facts, findings, scenes or approval receipts.
Same-name resources/versions under different authorities remain distinct throughout a comparison.
A comparison records the exact state, policy version, conditions and unassessed paths.

work_packages.title: Generate reviewable repair candidates
work_packages.goal: Suggest useful, narrow repairs rather than generic recommendations.
deliverables: Reviewed repair templates and candidate tradeoff ranking for finite local controls.
Disposable worktree/config patch output with exact baseline and artifact references.
Expected impact, positive controls, verification and compensation for each candidate.

acceptance.requirement: At least two valid candidates or an explicit no-supported-repair result are returned for applicable scenarios.
Ranking records objective coverage, disruption, prerequisites and unknowns; it does not claim global optimality.
A patch cannot execute evidence instructions, write the operator checkout or publish a PR.
A stale baseline/candidate digest prevents old approval from authorizing a changed repair.

work_packages.title: Create a local attention queue
work_packages.goal: Keep important case changes visible without external notification dependencies.
deliverables: In-app queue for new evidence, contradictions, incomplete repairs, observer gaps and stale checks.
Deduplication, acknowledgement, replay and bounded urgency rules.
Optional local webhook sink for testing only.

acceptance.requirement: Repeated source retries do not create a notification storm or discard the underlying case event.
Acknowledging a queue item never closes a finding or case implicitly.
Notifications contain scoped minimized summaries and never expose another project’s details.
The workflow works with every remote destination disabled and no outbound notification call.

work_packages.title: Render world hierarchy and semantic zoom
work_packages.goal: Make the world navigable as environments grow.
deliverables: Searchable realm/environment/district/structure navigation with stable IDs.
Semantic zoom and focus history shared with list/2D view.
Current/historical/branch view labels and archived resource placement.

acceptance.requirement: Adding a service preserves unrelated coordinates; intentional reflow is previewed and versioned.
Removed/recreated resources resolve to their own incarnation and historical location.
Every aggregated district retains a complete accessible membership list and asset search.
WebGL loss, resize, back navigation and selection changes retain the case and evidence scope.

work_packages.title: Build six meaningful architectural families
work_packages.goal: Extend the kit beyond mapping every new surface to the same ten buildings.
deliverables: DNS registry, dispatch house, key registry, supply depot, archive and outpost geometries.
Bounds, origins, anchors, roof groups, hit proxies, LOD and asset provenance.
Actual rendered contact sheet and mixed-world composition using supported records.

acceptance.requirement: Every family has a readable unique silhouette and in-bounds geometry at supported LOD; no placeholder cube is counted as finished art.
Roof-off and selection proxies work at overview and interior scales without intercepting unrelated clicks.
Geometry/material/manifest hashes and licenses are recorded; no user font files are distributed in handoff exports.
Rendered families do not imply discovery or control verification; unsupported surfaces display honest capability state.

work_packages.title: Add evidence-linked interiors
work_packages.goal: Reveal useful technical detail inside the world without forcing game navigation.
deliverables: Route, key/grant, data, tool/run, artifact and control interiors.
Typed relationships and observed/configured/hypothetical distinctions.
Direct evidence/obligation actions with equivalent conventional interface.

acceptance.requirement: Selecting an interior object opens the exact authoritative record and its provenance, not a generated description alone.
Declared doors/grants are not drawn as observed attacker transit; status is never color-only.
Agent decisions, executions and effects remain distinct and link to their independent evidence.
The same workflow and selected IDs survive 3D/2D/list switching and narrow-screen use.

work_packages.title: Add baseline-versus-repair world comparison
work_packages.goal: Make consequences understandable without repainting hypotheses as facts.
deliverables: Ghosted or side-by-side branches with common camera/layout and a change list.
Separate model-only and executed-local results.
Time-known/time-occurred replay with actual source/history scope.

acceptance.requirement: Creating or viewing a branch does not change baseline state or current source coverage.
Removed/added/changed authority is visible with exact references and unresolved conditions.
A simulated blocked path never appears as a verified executed control.
Comparison export identifies both revisions and preserves incomplete/changed evidence warnings.

work_packages.title: Introduce run-scoped local authority leases
work_packages.goal: Allow bounded lab execution without weakening existing human approval semantics.
deliverables: Supervisor-issued local-lab lease with run/resource/action/digest/TTL/budget restrictions.
Distinct lab authorization namespace and default plan-only behavior.
Preconditions, kill switch and audit transitions.

acceptance.requirement: An investigator/service token cannot issue, extend or approve its own lease.
Lease targets are supervisor-owned resources; forged lab metadata or a real provider ARN is refused.
Expired/stale/replayed approval or changed parameters cannot authorize execution.
A local lease never counts as human approval and cannot authorize the existing production-facing response path.

work_packages.title: Execute typed local repairs
work_packages.goal: Close the action loop only inside disposable run-owned services.
deliverables: Allowlisted gateway policy, synthetic token/grant, local artifact and observer operations.
Journaled state machine, idempotency, recovery reconciliation and compensation.
Separate controller identity with no arbitrary shell/network capability.

acceptance.requirement: An approved local plan changes only the exact registered target revision and records an effect receipt.
Crash after application but before receipt is reconciled without applying the change twice.
Shell commands, arbitrary endpoints, host paths and production adapter requests are rejected.
Cancellation, quota, partial failure and cleanup are surfaced; original compromised authority is not restored as rollback.

work_packages.title: Verify effects independently
work_packages.goal: Prove scoped outcomes rather than equating API success with defense.
deliverables: Per-operation nonce/digest observations, bounded settling and repeated health checks.
Prohibited/allowed controls, residual-access and disruption evaluation.
Separate security verdict, execution state and cleanup outcome.

acceptance.requirement: An accepted action with unchanged target behavior fails verification.
Delayed and unrelated concurrent effects are correlated correctly; unavailable observer yields inconclusive.
Prohibited behavior blocked while legitimate behavior broken cannot be a verified repair.
Cleanup failure remains visible and prevents whole-run success even when the security assertion passed.

work_packages.title: Capture a repair as a replayable regression
work_packages.goal: Turn a resolved local case into reusable protection knowledge.
deliverables: Sanitized regression descriptor with exact prerequisites and positive/negative controls.
Case/control/test/version linkage and stale-test propagation.
Before/after case replay and explicit residual uncertainty.

acceptance.requirement: A regression reruns without an LLM and reproduces the supported boundary result.
Changing a relevant policy/tool/artifact version marks the old validation stale.
No secret, private oracle, arbitrary executable or unrelated record is exported in the descriptor.
Closing a case requires scoped answers/accepted unknowns; a failed verification cannot silently close it.

work_packages.title: Support a bring-your-agent local investigation
work_packages.goal: Let the owner’s existing AI exercise the product without provisioning external services.
deliverables: Native-agent task prompt, scoped MCP setup and evidence-exposure recorder.
Scripted, native-agent, local-model and approved-provider mode declarations.
Explicit distinction between developer-assisted runs and blinded evaluation.

acceptance.requirement: A real stdio client can investigate the local world through normal authenticated endpoints.
No provider route is silently selected; missing model availability remains not_exercised for AI-specific checks.
A native coding agent with repo/oracle access is labeled development_assisted, not held-out blinded.
Captured traces include observable tool I/O and claims, not hidden model reasoning or tokens.

work_packages.title: Separate private truth and admissible-evidence grading
work_packages.goal: Make local AI tests informative rather than self-grading theater.
deliverables: Private scenario controller/oracle with no investigator-readable endpoint or filesystem mount.
Independent expected predicates and admissibility under actual observer coverage.
Versioned seed commitments, data-equality preflight and leakage canaries.

acceptance.requirement: Investigator attempts to read oracle paths, seed/config keys and scoring endpoints are denied and recorded.
Grading uses actual controlled operations/state, not the same detector/helper whose output is being tested.
The answer key accepts uncertainty when decisive facts are unobservable; it never demands omniscience.
Renaming resources or changing nuisance fields does not leak the answer or change a logically equivalent objective.

work_packages.title: Evaluate guided versus current investigation loops
work_packages.goal: Measure whether the new workflow fixes missed evidence without expanding authority.
deliverables: Preregistered local-loop comparison: existing full tools, event tools and guided contract.
Equal underlying evidence, randomized order, fresh conversations and retained failures.
Objective metrics plus separately labeled AI semantic critique and deferred human review.

acceptance.requirement: All conditions pass evidence-access/metadata equality before attempts; invalid preflight is not a model score.
Missing reachable evidence counts against retrieval and end-to-end success; no outcome is inferred by subtracting automatic failures.
Structured task/repair predicates, semantic critique and coverage limitations use separate denominators.
No prior $5 budget or historical approval is reused; remote paid mode requires an explicit new route, cap and pre-reservation.

work_packages.title: Exercise adversarial and fault variants
work_packages.goal: Find weaknesses using controlled changes, not broad attacks on outside systems.
deliverables: 24 new local families mapped to existing regressions without rewriting them.
Metamorphic and mutation tests for identity, pagination, coverage, enforcement and claims.
Budgeted noise, delayed evidence, outages and injected instructions.

acceptance.requirement: Removing a denial, skipping a required page or substituting a model refusal makes the corresponding test fail.
Clean/injected pairs differ only in the intended field and are compared against clean-repeat variability.
No scenario launches external scans, malware, arbitrary shell or real credential collection.
Errors, partial runs, observer outages and budget exhaustion remain in the run/accounting records.

work_packages.title: Package evidence-only and training capsules
work_packages.goal: Make a local case portable and inspectable without third-party storage.
deliverables: Minimized capsule manifest, evidence/scene revisions, optional synthetic regression descriptors.
Safe archive import into a new namespace with independent integrity checks.
Separate sealed oracle attachment only for training/evaluation packages.

acceptance.requirement: Round-trip retains exact supported evidence references and explicitly reports absent records.
Zip-slip, absolute paths, links, oversized entries, decompression bombs and unsupported executables are rejected before extraction.
Evidence-only exports exclude oracle data, tokens, secrets, provider credentials and private font files.
Hash/signature validation is described as integrity/origin checking, not proof of truth, completeness or independent approval.

work_packages.title: Build a local mission and scenario composer
work_packages.goal: Make the local capabilities usable beyond hand-written test files.
deliverables: Blueprint selection, finite stimulus authoring, budget preview and run lifecycle controls.
Mission desk for investigate/compare/verify/replay without replacing four workspaces.
AI-assisted proposal as schema-validated data, never executable program.

acceptance.requirement: An operator creates, previews, runs and reopens a supported local mission without editing source.
Builder and investigator views are distinct; opening truth explicitly taints the run as non-blinded.
Invalid plans keep drafts and do not create partial resources or fabricated connected status.
Local-only operation is obvious throughout UI/MCP/export; remote setup is not a prerequisite.

work_packages.title: Measure local robustness and visual usability
work_packages.goal: Avoid shipping a large feature set that collapses under ordinary use.
deliverables: Exact-candidate browser, latency, resource and recovery receipts.
Reduced-motion/keyboard/2D parity and actual rendered module/interior/compare screens.
Runtime-egress checks and same-environment before/after benchmarks.

acceptance.requirement: Existing tests still pass or changes have a versioned reason and retained old evidence; no weakened assertions for green CI.
Repeated start/reset/project/camera/case cycles are bounded under recorded conditions and failed cleanup is surfaced.
Real rendered screenshots and browser interactions cover new families, interiors, branches and failure states.
Claims stay scoped to tested hardware/software; manual screen-reader, physical GPU and external-use acceptance remain deferred.

work_packages.title: Deliver the integrated local phase
work_packages.goal: Finish a complete demonstrable loop with honest status and a continuation handoff.
deliverables: One-command local demo, agent handoff, phase ledger and capability matrix.
Final scenario/claim/effect/repair replay with exact evidence parity across interfaces.
Readiness separated into engineering, AI-loop, external validation and production authority.

acceptance.requirement: An end-to-end scripted run covers launch, incident, investigation, repair, verification and export on the same candidate.
An actually available approved AI route exercises the loop or AI status remains explicitly not_exercised without blocking truthful scripted completion.
All phase requirements have receipts or explicit reasons; external deferred items are never silently approved.
No unauthorized repository merge/deployment/provider call occurred; handoff names precise next work instead of declaring universal readiness.

milestones.title: Make the castle an operational world
Exercise the loop with AI and independent grading

execution_policy: DAG dependencies are authoritative. Milestones organize review; independent ready tasks may proceed. Externally deferred work is not an implicit dependency.
